reviews.text:
I randomly walked into Cannabis Island from the street, and I’m SO glad I did. The prices are really good, but what made the experience special was the owner - she is honestly one of the sweetest and most service-minded people I’ve met.

We got talking and I mentioned that it was my birthday, and she immediately made the whole experience feel so special. I got to choose a free grinder, she added a cute little bow to my bag, and even gave me an extra gram as a birthday gift 🥹🎀

It was such a small thing, but it genuinely made me feel so appreciated and taken care of. The service was above and beyond, and it ended up being the perfect ending to my birthday.

Amazing prices, amazing service, and such a lovely owner. I’ll absolutely be coming back. 💕
